summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp., a British Columbia-domiciled pharmaceutical preparations issuer formerly named ImmunoPrecise Antibodies Ltd., filed a Form 6-K for the period ended July 31, 2026. The submission consists overwhelmingly of inline XBRL taxonomy tags covering IFRS financial statement line items—property, plant and equipment, intangibles, leases, share capital, warrants, options and RSUs—plus geographic revenue and subsidiary breakdowns. No transaction, stake, price, recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. This is a routine foreign private issuer interim reporting filing, with no special-situation or risk-arb angle to monitor.
